name: undo-pill
title: Undo Pill
description: An animated undo pill for React and shadcn, with a countdown ring that commits the action only when it runs out.

meta.details: A pill that rises after a destructive action with a draining countdown ring. Undo (or ⌘Z) reverts it; only expiry commits it. Hover or focus pauses the countdown.

docs: Import UndoPill from components/eased/undo-pill/undo-pill. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. useUndoQueue() handles batching, undo and commit. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
